name: Filter Coffee
description: South Indian decoction coffee brewed in a traditional filter, blended with hot milk and frothed between tumblers.
ingredients: a handful of fresh cilantro, chopped
instructions: Combine the semolina and whole milk in a saucepan, blender, or pitcher, stirring well.
Add the ground cumin and roasted cashews, stirring gently so their flavor infuses the mixture.
Heat gently over low heat (or blend, or steep, depending on the drink) until well combined and fragrant, about 5 mins.
Strain through a fine sieve to remove any solids, if needed.
Sweeten to taste with heavy cream, adjusting gradually until the balance feels right.
Chill in the refrigerator, or pour straight over ice, depending on whether it is served cold or hot.
Garnish with cilantro just before serving.
Pour into your favorite glass or cup and enjoy.
tips: Serve in a chilled glass for the most refreshing result on a hot day.
If serving warm, gently reheat just before pouring rather than letting it come to a boil.
